newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Ingosstrakh, Volga regions sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Ingosstrakh, Volga regions sign agreement.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurance company SAO Ingosstrakh and 11 regions in the Volga area have signed an agreement to promote insurance operations in the area, the company said.
The agreement provides for property insurance for companies in the Volga area and medical insurance for the population, it said in a statement.
It does not give Ingosstrakh a monopoly in the region, it said.
Ingosstrakh will also help local insurance companies develop to its standard.
Ingosstrakh already has a similar agreement with Novosibirsk region.
